name: Princess Princess: Hime-tachi no Abunai Houkago
original_name: プリンセス・プリンセス 姫たちのアブナい放課後
source:
Princess Princess is a story revolving around the lives of three boys chosen to dress up as girls at the all-boy school they attend, which also just happens to be the most elite school in the area. The main protagonist, Toru Kouno, has just transferred to a new all-boys school, Fujimori, after living with his uncle for a time. He is one such boy chosen to be one of the Hime (姫?) or "Princesses", which is a tradition at the school in order to break up the monotony of life surrounded by nothing but males. Students (based on certain qualifications) are selected to be Princesses and are made to dress up as girls and attend school functions like this.
At the beginning of the story, there are already two such Princesses, Yuujiro Shihodani and Mikoto Yutaka, known as the Western Princess and Eastern Princess respectively, due to their room location. Toru is convinced into becoming a Princess soon after entering the school though once he accepted the job, he found it to be much more enjoyable than he thought.

[from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Princess_Princess_(manga)#Visual_novel]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
《公主公主》围绕三名少年展开。他们就读于当地最顶尖的男校，却被选中男扮女装。主人公河野亨寄住叔父家一段时间后，刚刚转入男子学校藤森学园，也成为获选担任“公主”的少年之一。

“公主”是学校为打破全是男性的单调生活而设立的传统。符合特定条件的学生会被选中，必须穿女装参加学校活动。

故事开始时，学校已经有两名公主：四方谷裕史郎与丰实琴。两人因宿舍房间位置而分别被称为西公主和东公主。亨入学不久便被说服接下公主职务，真正接受后，却发现这份工作远比想象中有趣。

[译自 [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Princess_Princess_(manga)#Visual_novel]Wikipedia[/url]]
